head: Open season on the Predators’ net
paras: The Lightning (8-3-1) beat Winnipeg 6-4 on Thursday, while the Predators (4-4-5) lost 4-3 to Washington the same night. Going in, the Bolts are third in the Atlantic (tied for eighth in the NHL) and the Predators sixth in the Central (tied for 20th).

The Lightning ice the puck less than almost anyone (2nd), get into a lot of chippy games (2nd) and keep shots away from their net (3rd). The Predators, by contrast, ice the puck a lot (30th). They also keep things calm after the whistle (3rd lowest) and get pinned in their own end on long shifts (32nd). The Lightning are likely to get plenty of pucks to the net against the Predators, and they have the edge over the Predators on shot quality.

Brandon Hagel (8 G / 8 A / 16 P in 12 GP) leads the Lightning in scoring, with four goals in six games against Nashville since 2023-24. Nikita Kucherov (4 G / 11 A / 15 P in 12 GP) is next in line, with seven points in his last five games. Steven Stamkos (7 G / 8 A / 15 P in 13 GP) is tied for the Predators’ scoring lead. Filip Forsberg (5 G / 10 A / 15 P in 13 GP) shares it, with seven points in his last five games.
Andrei Vasilevskiy (6-3-0 / .876 SV% in 9 GS) will likely start for Tampa Bay, and Juuse Saros (3-3-4 / .902 SV% in 10 GS) for Nashville.

items.text: The Lightning are newly without Max Crozier, and have had to make do without Yanni Gourde all season.
Brandon Hagel has scored in three straight games against Nashville.
Filip Forsberg has scored in three straight games.
Ryan O'Reilly has a point in four straight games.

NSH.head: A tough matchup for the Predators
NSH.body: Even though Nashville has home-ice advantage, Tampa Bay has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Predators’ best way through is a penalty kill that holds up.

TBL.head: Advantage, the Lightning
TBL.body: Even though Nashville has home-ice advantage, Tampa Bay has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Predators can make it interesting if their penalty kill holds up.

calls.head: Open season on the Predators’ net
calls.body: The Lightning love to shoot, and the Predators keep letting teams do it. Get ready for a shooting gallery.

calls.head: Where the Lightning have the edge: shot quality
calls.body: The Lightning are one of the league’s best for shot quality, and the Predators are around the middle. That’s the biggest gap between these two, and it isn’t a big one.
